messages:
Elaine C: Quick sync — final prelaunch checklist for Plume webinar + launch posts. Need redirects, schema snippets, kw mapping, and inbound routing ready by EOD Wed. TL;DR tasks below.

Mike J: assigning: redirects + canonical table -> you. Sofia -> schema & FAQ markup. Raj -> inbound routing + GTM UTM matrix. I can own keyword mapping and post copy review.

Sofia R: noted. For schema I have a small JSON-LD snippet we should reuse for all webinar landing pages. Will paste in a sec. @Mike J can you confirm the canonical pattern?

Mike J: canonical pattern = https://www.redwood.ai/plume (no trailing slash), landing variants -> add rel=canonical to head. Redirects: 301 old URLs -> canonical. csv sample below.

Mike J: ```
source_path,target,redirect_type,notes
/plume-launch-2026,https://www.redwood.ai/plume,301,Old campaign slug -> canonical
/plume-webinar,https://www.redwood.ai/plume,301,webinar friendly slug
```

Sofia R: JSON-LD snippet (small, validated):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Plume: Low-latency Inference","startDate":"2026-04-14T10:00:00Z","eventStatus":"https://schema.org/EventScheduled","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference","url":"https://www.redwood.ai"}}
```

Raj P: inbound routing notes — need: 1) GTM param set, 2) mapping table for landing->sales-lane, 3) webhook to hubspot for webinar signs. Draft GTM params: `?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=plume_apr26`. Putting mapping sheet in the drive: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/PLUME-MAPPING

Elaine C: acceptance criteria: redirects uploaded to infra bucket + smoke tested, schema present on all landing variants, keywords mapped to 3 pillar posts, and GTM routing tested with webhook. If any blocker ping infra-oncall.

Mike J: infra upload path: `s3://redwood-deploy/redirects/plume-2026.csv`. After upload, hit deploy-bot: `/deploy redirects plume-2026` -> will roll out to CDN.

Olivia (seo-bot): Heads up — sitemap update detected on staging. Run `curl https://staging.redwood.ai/sitemap.xml | grep plume` to confirm, then submit to Search Console. :robot_face:

Sofia R: quick Q — do we want FAQPage schema on the blog launch posts too or only on landing? Adding FAQ to posts could help snippet real estate.

Elaine C: add FAQ to top 2 launch posts only (A/B test). Raj please include in routing notes which variant gets FAQ.

Raj P: will do. I'll also add a note to the mapping sheet for the AB flag and audience tag.

Mike J: I'll prep the redirect CSV and upload this afternoon. Will ping once the deploy-bot job completes. :zap:

Elaine C: awesome — last mile: everyone add a 1-line status to the sheet by EOD. If anything slips, escalate here. Thanks! :raised_hands:
